contract: King Slime finisher card (docs/design/king_finisher_2026-10-08.md): the kill is unchanged for everyone; a paid contributor with an accepted manual hit (swing / Q / Z by hand, not auto) within the ContributorWindow gets Fx FinisherCard { Id, Kind, Seconds, Stat, Help { Item, N, Score }, Tickle { Gold, Score } }; c->s FinisherPick(id, Help | Tickle) only for the open card, its Id, within Seconds + Grace, once, 0.3 s rate; Fx FinisherEnd { Id, Pick, Stat, Score, Item, N, Gold }. Help = 2 Jelly (a full bag pays the rest at sell price), Tickle = 4 bank gold 'Finisher' (not a 2x source). My side +1 inside Deeds (5 a KST day, the one P9 cap), the other side -1 (A23-58, floor 0, off-side / rank-down lines), Neutral the gift only; AddStat only (no weekly ranking). One open card at a time; not picked / left = None. Metric FinisherPick (Halo | Horns | None, faction). Signal Picked(player, pick, kind).
limitations: The client card (game dev 1) is not here. Kills run through the real CombatService / SkillService presses and MonsterService's real DamageMonster + killRecord (cut out) in the combat world; the other MonsterService parts, the real ProgressionService (its 2x passes) and TelemetryService are doubles. A field's later ticks (X) pass the cast's own press: checked as source text only.
